title: Allay Companion
description: Replaces the totem of undying with an animated allay entity that moves around with you.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75cff39fafe52d89abf6fca56d8c2a1962624453.png)

# Datapack - Totem of Undying
Adds a **lively**, **animated** and **interactable** Allay to your Minecraft World. 
It follows you around anywhere you go, dances to music, plays with itself and **protects you from your certain fall**.

## How?
The Allay gets spawned in when any player holds a **Totem of Undying**. That Allay follows the Player anywhere they go. Each Player has their own Allay.

![Allay dances to music](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3f178db93897f1915fa34890dc490cb7d894446.gif)

![Allay follows player](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2701f74dbaff3ce8f4b541e651facfe86e735421.gif)

## FAQ?

### How do you spawn the Allay?
-> You need to hold a **Totem of Undying** in either Hand.

### How do I activate the Datapack?
-> You can activate the Datapack by selecting it in the World creation menu or manually open the folder of an existing world and putting the .zip in /datapacks. 

### The Datapack tells me its incomatible or broken.
-> If the version you're playing on is supported by the datapack on modrinth, don't worry about this.

### My Allay despawned.
-> It got out of Range, wait a couple seconds or re-equip the totem.

### My Totem is still in my Hand.
-> Download the optional resource pack from either of the "R" versions under "Supplementary resources".

### Where is my datapack?
-> The datapack is located in the world creation menu or is automatically applied to every world.

### Why is my datapack a Mod?
-> The datapack is recommended to be downloaded as the "Mod version". This doesn't change anything about its content. The Mod version is just more user-friendly.

## How to install?
### Server-side
Download the datapack version and put the .zip file in the /datapacks directory of your server.

### Client-Side or Singleplayer
Download the Mod version of the datapack and play any world.

![Allay floating](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d7c0dd97eccd6a1cdb0b583a54244d1ad7c8f13.png)
